cluster.label: Membrane protein NCLs
cluster.summary: NCLs caused by a broken membrane protein (lysosome or ER); infused enzymes are not expected to help.

members.label: CLN3 disease
members.summary: The most common form of Batten disease. It usually starts at school age with vision loss, followed by seizures and loss of skills.

members.label: CLN6 disease
members.summary: A rare inherited brain disease of childhood with seizures, vision loss and loss of movement and speech skills.

top_phenotypes.label: Seizure
top_phenotypes.summary: Sudden bursts of abnormal electrical activity in the brain (fits).

top_mechanisms.label: Lysosomal/ER membrane protein dysfunction
top_mechanisms.summary: A broken protein that is built into a membrane (of the lysosome or the endoplasmic reticulum). It cannot simply be replaced by an infusion.

top_mechanisms.label: Lysosomal degradation (ceroid lipofuscin storage)
top_mechanisms.summary: Cells break down worn-out parts inside lysosomes. In all NCLs this recycling fails and waste (lipofuscin) builds up, especially in nerve cells.
